nusmp.skill.book_mercury.description: Nozel Silva's attribute: liquid metal, dense and able to take any shape - blades that float, spears that fall like rain, an eagle that carries you through the air, a cage that closes on your foes. Cast the Silver Guardian and the mercury coats you: chrome plates, a pair of eagle wings, a ripple of silver over your skin. It is poisonous, and weak against fire. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_blade: Silver Blade - three double-edged blades of liquid mercury pour from your hand, hang in the air and fly at the target one after the other, hardening mid-flight. Mercury scales hard with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.mercury_shield: Silver Guardian - the mercury coats your whole body and rises round you in a dome for eight seconds: shots sink into it, blows land at half strength (fire melts through). The toxin costs you half a hit point a second, never below six. When it ends the dome flows back into spears and hurls them at everything near.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.mercury_rain: Silver Rain - a cloud of mercury overhead lets fall a storm of needle-fine spears where you aim, and a pool of silver spreads below. (Nozel Silva)
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_eagle: Silver Eagle - a giant eagle of living mercury forms under you and carries you along your line of sight, cutting and scattering all it passes; you land where it dissolves. Its wingspan and bite grow with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_bullet: Mercury Magic: Silver Bullet - five to eight small spheres of condensed mercury, thrown fast in a spread.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_spear: Mercury Magic: Silver Spear - one to three spears of mercury launched at the target (the middle one homes); they pierce, and fire melts them.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_shining_r: Mercury Magic: Silver Shining Regal Spear - the palm held out, a long beam of shining mercury follows it for two seconds and cuts through everything in line; it breaks barriers on its way. The five-second coat forms.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_star_of_e: Mercury Creation Magic: Silver Star of Execution - the mercury is spread over the area and closes into a giant cage for five seconds: its bars launch spears at those inside, its shield plates block what is thrown back, and whoever tries to leave is turned back (the shared control lock; bosses are not held).
